tools.name: memory_dream
tools.description: Read-only dreaming pass over GJC's project memory: claim decomposition, injection-budget and dead-reference checks, bounded canonical/transcript evidence, optional advisory Jev consistency checks, and one private JSON+MD report under ~/.gjc-plugin/memory-dream. Never edits, deletes or enqueues GJC memory or session files; a report is not proof that a note is true.
